doc.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The one performance at Monterey with Louis Armstrong
summary: The only staging was at the Monterey Jazz Festival with Armstrong, Carmen McRae and Lambert, Hendricks and Bavan.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Then when we finally did - the only performance was Monterey Jazz Festival. Iola was on one stage, doing the narration. You couldn’t do the entire show, but we could – on the other stage with Louis Armstrong, Carmen McRae, Lambert, Hendricks, and Bavan, Louis’s band, and my band. She would read in between. Explain your part.

There was just a narration that tied the songs together into some kind of story – sequence could be followed. But it was primarily music, very few words, except what were in the lyrics. But the message got through. It was really an extraordinary night, because so many musicians came backstage afterwards that were so moved by it. Of course, with Louis Armstrong singing it, how could you miss?
